launchRequirements.requiredEvidence: Confirm TNC, elected luxury ground TNC, or applicable for-hire carrier model and supporting filings; do not assume another platform's permits apply.
Broker/insurer verification of coverage in each operating period, exclusions and required written driver disclosures; a generic insurance upload is insufficient.
Actual screening provider results covering required criminal, sex-offender and driving-record searches, eligibility review and renewal dates; approval must not be inferred from a document title.
Verified driver photo and assigned license plate displayed before boarding. PIN verification supplements identity checks.

Public reporting procedure, recorded complaints, prompt block on accepting new rides for an impairment complaint, investigation and controlled reinstatement. Phone access alone does not implement this workflow.
Driver notice and training, nondiscrimination/service-animal handling, no disability surcharge and complaint review.
Fare or calculation disclosed before ride and electronic receipt including actual trip origin, destination, total time/distance and fare paid; estimate distance is not actual distance.
Confirm applicable MIA, FLL, PBI, PortMiami and Port Everglades access agreements, pickup fees and staging rules before activating each location.
Verify applicable ride/driver retention, account-deletion exceptions, restricted document storage and audit access.
Review applicable Florida independent CPA examination/reporting and other operator obligations for the selected classification.

comparisonLimits: Uber/Lyft PIN and screening protocols are design references, not legal permissions, screening integrations, emergency monitoring or 24/7 staffing supplied to B1. Jets and boats require separate regulatory review. Florida rules do not establish Argentina requirements.
classificationNote: Scheduled/prearranged trips do not by themselves exempt an operator from Florida transportation requirements.

tncInsuranceReference.additionalReview: Review applicable PIP, uninsured/underinsured motorist requirements, insurer eligibility, gaps and written disclosures under 627.748(7)-(8). Limits alone do not establish coverage.

beforeFirstAccess: local/national criminal screening with primary-source validation
National Sex Offender Public Website search
tncScreeningReference.note: Actual screening date, scope and statutory disqualifiers require documented review. Upload/approval date is not the screening date. Annual screening used by competitors is a reference, not a claim that B1 has integrated a screening vendor.
